property_summary: For any caller f, recipient t and token id, transferFrom(f, t, id) must revert whenever f does not own token id (here: no id is ever externally mintable, so every id is unowned and the call must always revert); the mutant removes the WRONG_FROM check so the call succeeds and mints ownership of an arbitrary id, making ownerOf(id) == t.
change_summary: Remove the WRONG_FROM check so transferFrom succeeds for arbitrary `from`, overwriting `_ownerOf[id]` even when `from` is not the owner.
